description:
This connector gives your assistant secure, permissioned access to your real Kai data, so you can run your day just by asking.

Once connected, your assistant can:

- Calendar: read your schedule and create, reschedule, or cancel events across Google Calendar and Outlook Calendar.

- Email: search your inbox, read full threads, and draft replies in your voice across Gmail and Outlook. It sends only when you tell it to.

- Meetings: review your meeting recaps, summaries, and action items, and turn those items into tasks.

- Tasks: see your open tasks, capture new ones with due dates and priorities, update them, and mark them done.

You approve the connection once, on Kai's own screen. Nothing is sent, changed, or deleted without you asking.

Find more about Kai at hirekai.ai.

defaultPrompt: What does my day look like? Show my calendar and my open tasks.
Which emails need my attention today?
Analyze my recent customer meetings and pull out the feedback that keeps coming up.
